_comment: Contract-activity rows that MFL's own record CONTRADICTS. Each one was
verified individually against export?TYPE=transactions and the live
rosters export before being listed here -- this is a declaration of
verified findings, NOT a heuristic. An earlier heuristic version of this
check (same-day LOAD_ROSTERS add+remove) also flagged Christian
McCaffrey's real $62,000 franchise tag, because tagging a player you
already roster legitimately removes and re-adds him to restamp the
contract. Dropping real contracts to catch fake ones is the worse error,
so the rule was replaced with this list.
ROOT CAUSE, still open: the Front Office's FA-Contract flow writes a
contract_activity row with test_flag = 0 even when the submission never
reaches MFL. All 8 'FA Contract' rows in the 2026 log lack any
corroborating MFL roster movement, and the four below are positively
contradicted. Fixing the writer is the real repair; this file stops the
bad rows reaching print in the meantime.

rows.evidence: LOAD_ROSTERS added and removed him from 0001 the same day. He was auctioned twice after that -- won by 0010 at $16,000 on 2026-07-16, then by 0009 at $58,000 on 2026-07-27 -- and sits on 0009 today at $28,000 Vet-FAA-BL. L.A. Looks never rostered him.

LOAD_ROSTERS added and removed him from 0009 the same day, minutes either side of the identical $46,000 Burrow row. He is on 0010 today at $88,000 Vet-FAA, the highest price in the Free Agent Auction.

LOAD_ROSTERS added and removed him from 0001 the same day. He IS on 0001 now, but at $2,000 Vet-FAA, won at auction on 2026-07-31 -- a different contract entirely. Leaving this row in prints one player's contract twice at two different prices.

Zero MFL transactions of any type, ever, for this player id in 2026 -- no load, no free-agent move, no auction. He is unrostered league-wide today. The Front Office wrote the row and MFL never saw it.
